_doc: Patient pages that OFFICIAL, NON-REGIONAL UK producers list on their OWN index pages (fetched on 'built'; rows exist only because an index links them). type 'trusted' — the same class as the hand-kept national rows. `quality` is gap_fill_check's page-observable stamp (loads, reading age, review date / PIF TICK, producer named); the picker and patient page offer a row ONLY when quality.pass is true. A row that leaves its index is kept as 'delisted' with its pass retired. Patient.info rows are PATIENT-side only (/doctor excluded). medrics writes none of this and endorses nothing. Decision record, 2026-09-22 (specs/leaflets.md G-picker-4).
